title: Instantiate Child Scene window in Godot 4.4 does not display all scenes availbe in addons directory
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducable in: v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

Not Reproducable in Godot 4.3

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated AMD FirePro W2100 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 27.20.21026.2006) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7600 CPU @ 3.50GHz (4 threads)

### Issue description

In Godot 4.4 the Instantiate Child Scene window that lets you link to other scenes from the scene you're developing was revised.  Now if you want to link  to a scene within the addons/ directory, you need to click the addons check box in the lower right corner.  However, if you do this, only some addons are displayed.  

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9e9a3956-ab48-4474-b959-fccb39733523)

If I recall correctly, the first time I tried to do this this list was longer.  It was missing some scenes, but I could still choose from among several.  After selecting one scene, it now only displays that one scene that I picked the first time.

I started discussing it in this thread:
https://forum.godotengine.org/t/linking-scenes-in-gotot-4-4-is-much-worse-than-it-was-before/104858/4

### Steps to reproduce

Open a project that has an addon and create a new scene.  Then try to add  a child  to that scene that is a link to another scene that is inside of the addons directory.  The Instantiate Child Scenes dialog will misbehave.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I tried uploading a zip file, but Github wouldn't allow it.  Yuo can download https://github.com/blackears/cyclopsLevelBuilder and convert it to Godot 4.4, but this should happen with any project with addons.
